method: Actual visual inspection of four final PNGs with view_image

images.notes: Whole tower and antennas fit; mapped skyline, crown and lake visible; no blocking foreground.

Open river, boat, Jackson foreground parapet and Adams bridge beyond; no camera-facing facade obstruction. Fine path-tracing grain remains in shadows and reflections.
Localized warm pools on the riverbanks and bridge, warm/cool window groups, lit boat side, long ripple reflections and readable foreground parapet; scene retains appropriate night darkness.
